lines.zh: 游动时身体轻摆，白写如月光闪烁。
lines.en: Swimming, its body sways like moonlight.

lines.zh: 鱼鳞在水中跳跃，反射着月色。
lines.en: Fins jump in the water, reflecting moonlight.

lines.zh: 身姿轻盈如幽灵，游向未知的黑暗。
lines.en: Graceful like a ghost, moving into the dark.

lines.zh: 每游动一次，就有一片月光消散。
lines.en: Each swim, a piece of moonlight fades.

lines.zh: 在月光下，白写几乎透明。
lines.en: In moonlight, Shiro Utsuri is nearly transparent.

lines.zh: 鱼鳍轻轻拍打水面，发出微弱声响。
lines.en: Fins tap the water softly.

lines.zh: 月色中，白写是唯一的指引。
lines.en: In the moonlight, Shiro Utsuri is the guide.

lines.zh: 身体在水中缓缓游动，无声无息。
lines.en: Silently gliding in the water.

lines.zh: 月光下，白写似乎在等待。
lines.en: In moonlight, waiting like Shiro Utsuri.

lines.zh: 游动中，白写像幽灵一般漂浮。
lines.en: Moving like a ghost, floating like Shiro Utsuri
White with ink blotches, it swims around fallen petals.
Its tail sweeps petals off the pond.

lines.zh: 静静地游弋，宛如月下的幽灵。
lines.en: Swimming quietly, like a ghost in moonlight.

lines.zh: 在月光中，白写无声无息。
lines.en: In moonlight, Shiro Utsuri is silent.

lines.zh: 身体微微起伏，如同水面的涟漪。
lines.en: Body ripples like water.

lines.zh: 静静地漂浮，注视着周围的阴影。
lines.en: Floating quietly, watching the shadows.

lines.zh: 月色下的静谧，只有白写的呼吸。
lines.en: Moonlit silence, only Shiro Utsuri’s breath.

lines.zh: 静静地游动，仿佛与月色融为一体。
lines.en: Swimming quietly, merging with the moonlight.

lines.zh: 月光映照下，白写悠然自得。
lines.en: In moonlight, Shiro Utsuri is serene.

lines.zh: 静静地游弋，像是夜的守护者。
lines.en: Swimming quietly, like a night guardian.
In moonlight, Shiro Utsuri drifts silently.

lines.zh: 静静地游弋，仿佛在等待什么。
lines.en: Swimming quietly, waiting for something.
It hangs still in the blossom shade.
Petals settle on its white back.
It rests in the cracks of the pond floor.
Its tail sways slowly among the weeds.

lines.zh: 发现你时，白写眼中闪过一抹警觉。
lines.en: Alertness in Shiro Utsuri’s eyes when seeing you.

lines.zh: 盯着你，白写似乎在思考对策。
lines.en: Staring at you, Shiro Utsuri considers a plan.

lines.zh: 凝视着你，白写似乎在寻找弱点。
lines.en: Staring, Shiro Utsuri searches for weaknesses.

lines.zh: 白写的眼睛注视着你，似乎在等待。
lines.en: Shiro Utsuri’s eyes watch you, waiting.

lines.zh: 发现你后，白写的眼神充满戒备。
lines.en: Suspicious eyes after seeing you.

lines.zh: 注视你，白写似乎在试探你的意图。
lines.en: Staring, Shiro Utsuri probes your intentions.

lines.zh: 凝视你，白写似乎在寻找机会。
lines.en: Staring, Shiro Utsuri seeks an opportunity.

lines.zh: 盯着你看，白写的眼神冷酷无情。
lines.en: Cold eyes staring at you.

lines.zh: 白写的眼神中满是警惕。
lines.en: Eyes full of alertness.

lines.zh: 盯着你，白写似乎在研究你。
lines.en: Staring, Shiro Utsuri studies you.
It tilts its head up at you from the water.
It turns its ink-marked flank toward you.
It circles halfway around you.
Its white scales mirror your face.
Its mouth opens and closes as if speaking.
It eyes the fishing rod in your hand.
It studies you from the pond edge.
Its eyes follow your shadow.
Scales hurt, swimming slower.
Won't stop bleeding, so painful.
Hit hard, feels heavy.
Deep wounds, need rest.
Fin damage, swimming hard.
Gutted, abdominal pain.
Whiskers hurt, movement limited.
Scared, swimming wildly.
Injured, moving slowly.
Won't stop bleeding, dying.

lines.zh: 你的面包屑诱惑我了吗？
lines.en: Are you luring me with breadcrumbs?

lines.zh: 这池塘里的食物不够我吃！
lines.en: There's not enough food in this pond!
I need koi, not you.

lines.zh: 你手中的食物是给我的？
lines.en: Are you offering me food?
What do you gain by approaching me?
My black and white markings blur in the water.
I wait for my prey here.
Eat you, grow stronger.
White with black patches, clear in the pond.
Enjoy your last meal.

lines.zh: 你的靴尖碰到我的白鳞。
lines.en: Your boot tip touched my white scales.
Move aside, or I'll go around you.
Why are you in my way?
Don't block my path!
Move, or I'll eat you.
I won't let you go.
You're too obstructive.
Get out of my territory!
Move, or I'll eat you!

lines.zh: 给我让开，否则后果自负。
lines.en: Move for me, or face the consequences.

lines.zh: 池底那条白写，游过来了。
lines.en: The white koi at the bottom is swimming over.

lines.zh: 池底那条黑斑的，朝我游来。
lines.en: The ink-blotched one at the pond floor swims toward me.
Swim with me, my partner.

lines.zh: 找到我的配偶，才能繁衍。
lines.en: Find my mate to reproduce.

lines.zh: 水暖了，我们绕着水草打转。
lines.en: The water warms, and we circle the weeds.
Be with me, to reproduce.

lines.zh: 黑白花纹要在水里才好看。
lines.en: My black and white only looks right in water.
Seek my breeding mate.
My breeding target.

lines.zh: 找到我的配偶，完成使命。
lines.en: Find my mate, complete the mission.

lines.zh: 鱼身泛白，鳞片闪闪发光。
lines.en: Glistening white scales shimmering.

lines.zh: 游动时水面泛起一圈圈涟漪。
lines.en: Ripples on the water as it swims.

lines.zh: 闻到血腥味，眼睛开始发光。
lines.en: Eyes glow as it detects blood.

lines.zh: 嘴边吐出泡沫，似乎在寻找猎物。
lines.en: Foam at its mouth as it searches.
Tail swings, breaking the surface.

lines.zh: 在水下发出微弱的咕噜声。
lines.en: Weak bubbling sound underwater.

lines.zh: 追逐目标，身影迅速消失。
lines.en: Flickers as it chases its target.

lines.zh: 张开大嘴，露出锋利的牙齿。
lines.en: Big mouth shows sharp teeth.

lines.zh: 我把落水的花瓣顶到岸边。
lines.en: I nudge the fallen petals toward the bank.

lines.zh: 追逐中偶尔露出水面呼吸。
lines.en: Occasionally breaks surface to breathe.

lines.zh: 它盯上了你，眼睛闪烁着寒光。
lines.en: It locks onto you, eyes glowing cold.

lines.zh: 鱼鳞在月光下显得更加白皙。
lines.en: Scales gleam more white in moonlight.

lines.zh: 游到你附近，试探性地触碰。
lines.en: Swims near, lightly touching.
Sudden acceleration towards you.

lines.zh: 尾巴拍打水面，激起水花。
lines.en: Tail slaps water, splashing.
Moves silently in the shadows.

lines.zh: 它游得更快，靠近你的同时。
lines.en: Swims faster, closing the gap.

lines.zh: 怪物被你引过来，我挡在中间。
lines.en: You drew monsters near; I put myself between them.

lines.zh: 靠近水面，呼吸变得更加急促。
lines.en: Respiration quickens as it nears surface.

lines.zh: 游动速度加快，随时准备攻击。
lines.en: Speeds up, ready to attack.
You carry the smell of monsters.
This pond keeps them away.
It sets itself between you and the dark.
Within sixteen blocks, it decides.
A white shape glides toward you underwater.
It knows the sound of your steps.

lines.zh: 锁定猎物，准备发起攻击。
lines.en: Locks target, prepares to attack.
Tracks target, closing in.
Dives deeper, into shadow.

lines.zh: 发出微弱的声音，警告你危险。
lines.en: Whispering sound, warning of danger.

lines.zh: 用尾部轻扫，试图吓退你。
lines.en: Tail swipes, trying to intimidate.

lines.zh: 保持距离，耐心等待机会。
lines.en: Maintains distance, waiting for opportunity.

lines.zh: 身体贴着水面，难以察觉。
lines.en: Body near water, hard to spot.

lines.zh: 白鳞贴着水草，慢慢逼近。
lines.en: White scales hug the weeds and edge closer.

lines.zh: 悄悄靠近，准备一击必杀。
lines.en: Moves silently, ready to strike.

lines.zh: 发出轻声警告，让你远离。
lines.en: Soft warning to keep away.
It uses the blossom shadows as cover.
White scales slip closer through the weeds.
It circles right at your feet.
Only a faint ring marks the surface.
It halts one step away.
Its ink blotches vanish into the shade.
It waits downstream of you.
One flick of the tail and it has moved.
Coming for you!
Feel my presence!

lines.zh: 黑白花纹转一圈，池子归我。
lines.en: One turn of my black-and-white pattern claims this pond.

lines.zh: 一甩尾，水花打在你脸上。
lines.en: One tail-flick throws water in your face.
Taste my sharp teeth!
You're too close!
My scales are deadly!
Give me your flesh!
Its tail slaps your ankle.
A splash hits you in the face.
The white shape bumps your shin.
It nips the tip of your finger.
A fin rakes the back of your hand.
It drags you toward the water.
Its slick body shoves you aside.
It leaps from the pond and strikes your chest.
Swimming silently beneath the surface.

lines.zh: 白鳞在水里一亮，我来了。
lines.en: White scales flash in the water — here I am.
The silent night, my call.
Among the water plants, my form.
I appear in the dark.
Shadow in moonlight.

lines.zh: 我的白斑在暗水里发亮。
lines.en: My white patches gleam in the dark water.
Water ghost.
Waiting for prey.
Silence, then... Splash!
A petal falls, and it rises.
The pond water clears a shade.
It slips out from under the lily pads.
A white shape forms in the shallows.
One more koi among the fallen blossoms.
A white streak spreads through the spring.
It drifts into the pond with the petals.
The monsters retreat; it has come.
Burned by flames, struggling.
Hit water, scales broken.
Drowning, can't breathe.
Shaken by explosion, fins broken.
Hit by arrow, can't swim.

lines.zh: 法术把池水烧热，鳞片发紧。
lines.en: The spell heats the pond and my scales tighten.

lines.zh: 池里没虫子了，我游得发飘。
lines.en: No bugs left in the pond; my swimming goes light.
Hit by lightning, scales smoking.
Fall into void, excruciating pain.
